title: Running the Slide List: Send, Select, Keys and Layers | LayerCue from Zero, Episode 6
description:
Run one presentation live: clicking a picture sends, clicking the name only loads it; the arrow keys and Option + arrows; the seven layers; the layer chip (foreground, background, overlays); how overlays replace and stack; the orange on-air trail; the control row; and Lock editing before a show.
New here? Start with Episode 1: Meet LayerCue — The Main Window.
Recorded on LayerCue 0.9.12.
Manual: https://layercue.com/docs/output/layers/
The narration is AI-generated and the music is built from GarageBand loops. The school, sponsor and media in the demo are fictional.
